_about: Hand-curated inputs to titles.py (cc-gaps lane, 2026-11-15). Keys are title_key() forms: the display title, lower case, tags removed. Only file names and titles here, never ROM data.

aliases._about: Region-merged titles: the same game sold under another name. alias title -> the main title it merges into (one dump per title; the alias record is kept but marked extra.aliasOf). Found by matching internal header names (Genesis overseas name) plus known region renames; only renames where the game is the same program with a different name/logo, not a reskin (Kirby's Avalanche, Black Belt, Secret Command stay separate).

md.super shinobi ii, the: shinobi 3 - return of the ninja master
md.teenage mutant ninja turtles - return of: teenage mutant ninja turtles - the hyperstone heist

gg.shining force gaiden ii: shining force ii - the sword of hajya

include_untagged._about: Files in the No-Intro style folders that carry no region tag but are real retail games (not hacks): file names, matched case-insensitively. From the 219 untagged GameBoy Color files: 30 are byte-identical to a dump already in the catalog, the rest are hacks, colourisations, translations and fan games, except these.

known_revisions._about: Titles whose revisions are known to differ in ways the catalog cares about: every listed revision found in the library gets its own record (revisionOf = the main dump). Sources: default-db.json (the revision the 2026-09 certification graded) and the FCEUX movie-parity work (TAS movies are tied to one exact revision by MD5).

missing_originals._about: Titles that should be in the catalog but have no clean dump in X:\EMULATION (only a translation/hack or a patched proto). Not added (hacks/translations stay out); listed so the user can decide whether to source the originals. The SNES list (Japan-only titles present only under Translations) is in T:/BrokenDev/Catalog/reports/missing-originals-2026-11-15.json.
